participants: client: Mara (owner, Northwind Tea Co., a fictional shop)

goals.text: Know every Monday which teas make money once the ads are paid
goals.quote: Every Monday I want to know which teas actually make money once the ads are paid.

goals.text: Never run out of a tea while it is being pushed

words.meaning: A 50 g pouch of one tea, sold to try it.
words.quote: The little 50 gram pouches, we call those samplers.

words.meaning: A 250 g tin of one tea; what people come back for.
words.quote: The 250 gram tins are what people come back for.

words.meaning: Two weeks in which one tea gets the ads and the front page.
words.quote: A push is two weeks where one tea gets the ads and the front page.
words.note: said once; it may mean the front page only

stories.want: a Monday list of every tea with its profit after ad spend
stories.so_that: I stop pushing teas that lose money
done_when: every tea shows last week's sales, ad spend and profit
a tea that lost money is marked
the list is ready by 8:00 on Monday
stories.quote: Monday morning I want one list: what sold, what the ads cost, what is left.

stories.want: to approve each push before its ads start
stories.so_that: no push spends money I did not agree to
done_when: the push shows its daily cap and expected spend
nothing starts until I approve it
I can stop it at any time
stories.quote: Nothing should start spending before I say yes.

numbers.applies_to: the time from ordering Sencha to having it in the warehouse
numbers.quote: From the day we order, Sencha takes forty-five days to reach the warehouse.

numbers.applies_to: the most ads may spend in one day during a push
numbers.quote: Twenty, thirty dollars a day is what I can live with.

numbers.applies_to: the weeks of stock left that start a reorder
numbers.quote: When there are six weeks of stock left, we reorder.

numbers.applies_to: the time from ordering Sencha to having it in the warehouse
numbers.quote: In the rainy season it is more like sixty days.
numbers.note: maybe only in the rainy season

questions.text: Which currency is the daily cap in?
questions.quote: Twenty, thirty dollars a day is what I can live with.

suggest.because: The ad account bills in USD.

questions.text: Is the Sencha lead time 45 or 60 days?

suggest.because: Both were said; the second only for the rainy season.

questions.text: Who may approve a push when you are away?

suggest.value: Nobody: pushes wait until I am back
suggest.because: You said nothing should spend before you say yes.
